title: What If Swallowed Gum Really Stayed Inside You?

scenes.text: What if swallowed gum really stayed in you for seven years? The truth is stranger.
Your body can digest the sweeteners and flavors, but it has no enzymes for the gum base.
So the base travels through you whole, much like fiber does.
Within about two days, around 40 hours, it usually exits, roughly the same time as food.
Even in slow guts it usually passes in under seven days, not seven years.
The seven year story is folklore. Swallowed gum doesn't stay, it just takes a quick trip through you and leaves.

description:
What if swallowed gum stayed in you for seven years?
It is a myth: the gum base can't be digested, but it passes through like fiber.
